CONCAT(sys15_corp_nm, '(' || f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast08_account_id) || ')') AS corp_account_name, ast06_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id, f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', a.ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast06_company_id, ast06_date) || CASE WHEN substr(a.ast01_item_s_class_cd, 5) = '99' THEN '' ELSE '(' || f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', a.ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast06_company_id, ast06_date) || ')' END AS ast_class_name, f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast06_ast_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name, f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath(ast06_ast_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name, ast06_cur_cd AS cur_code, a.ast01_tr_unit AS tr_unit, ast08_qty AS qty, ast08_price AS price, ast08_tr_amt AS tr_amt, ast06_fee AS fee, ast06_amt AS amt, ast08_lock_up_period_cd AS lock_up_period_code, f_cdnm('LockUpPeriodCode', ast08_lock_up_period_cd, ast06_company_id, ast06_date) AS lock_up_period_name, ast08_lock_up_date AS lock_up_date, ast08_list_date AS list_date, ast08_account_id AS account_id, f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast08_account_id) AS account_name, ast08_tr_finance_id AS tr_finance_id, COALESCE(ast06_settle_mng_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS settle_mng_yn, ast06_deposit_id AS deposit_id, b.ast01_class_tree_nm AS deposit_name, ast06_note AS note, ast06_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ast06_person_id) AS person_name, act02_journal_id AS journal_id, ast06_appr_id AS appr_id, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, CASE WHEN act02_journal_id IS NULL THEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM act80_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr r ON r.apr01_appr_id = act80_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal j ON j.act02_journal_id = act80_journal_id WHERE ( act80_tr_id IN ( SELECT ast06_tr_id UNION SELECT ast07_settle_id FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) OR j.act02_tr_id IN ( SELECT ast06_tr_id UNION SELECT ast07_settle_id FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) ) AND r.apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') ) ELSE f_get_relate_dcr_count(act02_journal_id) END || ' 건' AS appr_cnt, ast05_dcr_class_tree_id AS dcr_class_tree_id

FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN ast05_tr_code ON (ast05_tr_cd = ast06_tr_cd AND ast05_company_id = ast06_company_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree a ON a.ast01_class_tree_id = ast06_ast_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON b.ast01_class_tree_id = ast06_deposit_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast06_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast08_tr_finance ON ast08_tr_id = ast06_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = ast06_appr_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_person_id, ast06_date, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_amt, ast06_fee, ast06_settle_mng_yn, ast06_note, ast06_deposit_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_corp_id, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_for_amt) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{r.date}, #{r.trCode}, #{r.amt}, #{r.fee}, #{r.settleMngYn}, #{r.note}, #{r.depositId}, #{r.astClassTreeId}, #{r.corpId}, COALESCE(#{r.curCode}, 'KRW'), 1.0, #{r.amt})
mapper.select: SELECT ast08_tr_finance_id FROM ast08_tr_finance WHERE ast08_tr_id = #{trId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast08_tr_finance (ast08_tr_finance_id, ast08_tr_id, ast08_account_id, ast08_qty, ast08_price, ast08_tr_amt, ast08_fee, ast08_lock_up_period_cd, ast08_lock_up_date, ast08_list_date) VALUES (#{financeId}, #{trId}, #{r.accountId}, #{r.qty}, #{r.price}, #{r.trAmt}, #{r.fee}, #{r.lockUpPeriodCode}, #{r.lockUpDate}, #{r.listDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE ast08_tr_finance SET ast08_account_id = #{r.accountId}, ast08_qty = #{r.qty}, ast08_price = #{r.price}, ast08_tr_amt = #{r.trAmt}, ast08_fee = #{r.fee}, ast08_lock_up_period_cd = #{r.lockUpPeriodCode}, ast08_lock_up_date = #{r.lockUpDate}, ast08_list_date = #{r.listDate} WHERE ast08_tr_finance_id = #{financeId}
